title: Traffic Rush
notes: Physical ARM64 test on 2026-10-07 with IPA SHA-256 5bf90565cb31cfa3c00da4743dd6cdd4fc3d5cc3cb935f0b19a27f729fa20bb3. The game process stays alive and initially shows score text and a swipe tutorial, but nearly the entire playfield consists of colored dotted artifacts. Within seconds the view becomes black except for BEST: 0 and score 0. A swipe did not restore the image. No distinct main menu or visible playable traffic scene was observed. This is a rendering-blocked launch, not verified gameplay; input, audio and saves remain untested.
